GJG 06/06/2026 RGC Spatial locations

Here, I am going to see if our RGC subclusters correspond to spatially distinct populations of RGCs. One caveat here this will not be dissection aware while I wait to hear back from Coltan re: which parts of sections should be excluded.

The steps will be 1) Subset visium object to be ONLY RGCs as defined by expression of markers gfap, LOC111577263, sox2, or gja1b 1a) Run SCT on visium RGC object 2) Subset multiome object and subcluster 2a) Because ependymal cells are also gfap+ and crocc2, the main marker, does not appear very strongly in the visium data, I will also include them 2b) 26, a dividing glial cluster will also be included 3) Use Seurat’s label transfer functionality to go multiome_RGC -> Spatial data 4) Make a heatmap of regions 5) Plot on spatial

From prior knowledge, I hypothesize that 1_shha, 1_NSC, and 1_NP will be along the medial ventricles while 1_gfap will be more filamentous.

Perfect, now, label transfer time

Balance object so that larger populations do not overwhelm the transfer

cells_per_cluster <- 200

set.seed(42)
cells_keep <- obj_rgc@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  group_by(sub_res0.2) %>%
  group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = min(cells_per_cluster, nrow(.x)))) %>%
  pull(cell)


obj_rgc_balanced <- subset(obj_rgc, cells = cells_keep)
vis_rgc$seurat_clusters.projected0.4 = droplevels(vis_rgc$seurat_clusters.projected0.4 )
# score distribution split by whether assignment was high confidence
vis_rgc$transfer_confident <- 
  vis_rgc$predicted.transferred_cluster.score > 0.5

cat("\nHigh confidence assignments:", 
    sum(vis_rgc$transfer_confident), "\n")
## 
## High confidence assignments: 54380
cat("Low confidence assignments:", 
    sum(!vis_rgc$transfer_confident), "\n")
## Low confidence assignments: 23977

Very good confidence

Plot against visium clusters

  vis_rgc$predicted.cluster=   vis_rgc$predicted.transferred_cluster[vis_rgc$transfer_confident==T]

agreement = table(vis_rgc$predicted.cluster,
                  vis_rgc$seurat_clusters.projected0.4)

pheatmap(
  agreement / rowSums(agreement),               # each region sums to 1
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = F,
  border_color = NA,
  color        = colorRampPalette(c("grey95", "orange", "darkred"))(100)
)

Ok so yeah they are overwhelmingly aligned to cluster 1 not a surprise, it looks like ependymal cells (15) are also a part of that cluster, dividing glia are kind of evenly divided.

Is there a spatial difference

renamed = c(
  'could be nPPa'= 'What',
  'could be nMMp' = 'nMMp',
  'could be nPMP' = 'nPMp',
  'dorsolateral nucleus' = 'Dln-r',
  'dorsolateral nucleus caudal part' = 'Dln-c',
  'Dl-v2 dorsal part' = 'Dl-v2d',
  'TGn' = 'TGN'
)

renaming_col = ifelse(vis_rgc$anatomical %in% c(names(renamed)), renamed[vis_rgc$anatomical], vis_rgc$anatomical)  
vis_rgc$anatomical_renamed = renaming_col

  vis_rgc$predicted.cluster=   vis_rgc$predicted.transferred_cluster[vis_rgc$transfer_confident==T]

agreement = table(vis_rgc$predicted.cluster,
                  vis_rgc$anatomical_renamed)

pheatmap(
  t(agreement / rowSums(agreement)),               # each region sums to 1
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = F,
  border_color = NA,
  color        = colorRampPalette(c("grey95", "orange", "darkred"))(100),
  fontsize=4)
